migrate-v18.description: Applies automated @clr/angular v17→v18 source migrations (templates, imports, CSS). Run with: ng generate @clr/angular:migrate-v18

ng-add.description: Adds @clr/angular to a project and optionally sets up AI coding agent files

ai-skills.description: Adds Clarity AI agent files (AGENTS.md section, optional Claude Code skills). Run with: ng generate @clr/angular:ai-skills
